test_title: PYST 8: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 04 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.**

Don't try to force the window open, or __you might broken__ it.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error is in the verb form **"broken."**
 
• The correct form is **"break,"** as in "you might break it."

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is:* 'Don't try to force the window open, or you **might break** it.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 **"you might breaks"** and Option 2** "you have break"** are incorrect grammatically.
